text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, as Super Creek and I
were talking about grabbing some tea—

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Going on carefree outings with an Umamusume...
You certainly seem to have plenty of time on your hands."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ? Um, who are you?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a Trainer too, you know.
From the same Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right?
So, an acquaintance of yours, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, shouldn't you be
more attentive and caring towards the Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle Series
are immensely important to an Umamusume, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't have the luxury
to be lazing around." his
choice_data_list: You need to take breaks too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
They might need something like that,
but I wonder if a Trainer really does.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course. If you keep working without rest,
you'll collapse. ...Besides,

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer cares about me.
It's okay, there's nothing to worry about~.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"With such naive thinking,
an Umamusume will never grow..."
choice_data_list: I have my schedule firmly planned out
It's not that I'm being naive...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
Trainer really is an amazing person.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're always studying so many things
to guide me forward.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You are a truly wonderful trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Sounds like it was none of my business.
Excuse me.

Trainer snorted with a "Hmph,"
and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you shouldn't let
what they said get to you too much.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We have our own pace, after all,
and besides...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she was troubled by something as well.
Her voice... sounded so very lonely.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, you don't have to...
choice_data_list: It's fine, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Splendid. In that case,
let us enjoy some tea at our leisure before heading home♪

"And so, Super Creek stayed close by my side
and walked with me until the very end of the day,
as if trying to be considerate of me."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
you know so many things that I don't.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "I am always saved by her vast knowledge and experience."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So, there is no need to worry.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Don't blame me if you end up regretting it
when it's too late.

Trainer snorted with a "Hmph,"
and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Are you still bothered by... what was said earlier?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, rather than what that person told you,
I want you to remember my words.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You are always helping me out so much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, when you intend to pamper someone,
you end up feeling like the one being pampered instead, you know?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So please, have confidence in yourself.
...Okay?

"And so, Super Creek stayed close by my side
and walked with me until the very end of the day,
as if trying to be considerate of me."
